title: Ceiling Shares on a Prepay Booking where the Growing Crop is Pledged, Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
Where the growing crop stands pledged to the cooperative, the share of the prior season spend a member may book as prepay on an account of the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts is set from that pledge and from the deliveries the account has taken, rather than from the share the programme carries.

Where a perfected security interest covering the growing crop is recorded on the account and eight or more deliveries were invoiced to it over the 14 statement months before the handling date, the ceiling share is 120 percent. Where such an interest is recorded on the account and fewer than eight deliveries were invoiced to it over those months, the ceiling share is 105 percent. In every other case no substituted ceiling share applies.

The security interest is read from the cooperative's own record of the account, never from the member's account of what their lender has filed. The deliveries counted are the deliveries invoiced to that account inside the window: seven leave the account in the lower band, and an eighth carries it to the upper one. Where no perfected security interest covering the growing crop is recorded on the account, the count of deliveries changes nothing.

*Worked on hypothetical figures.* A prior season spend of 180000.00 USD on an account carrying a recorded security interest and nine deliveries inside the window is measured against a ceiling share of 120 percent, and the ceiling is taken on 216000.00 USD; the same account with six deliveries inside the window is measured against 105 percent, and the ceiling is taken on 189000.00 USD.
